newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed in slow start to week.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed in slow start to week.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday.
Gasoline was firmer with NYMEX and Eurograde barges traded up to $210 a tonne fob ARA.
Naphtha eased towards the end of the day. June swaps traded at $187 and $187.50 a tonne fob ARA.

Fuel oil markets had a traditionally slow start to the week, with no trade seen on high sulphur barges by midday in Europe and offer levels down $1. Low sulphur swaps were soft with buying interest for physical poor.
Gas oil firmed on benchmark futures but amid slack demand. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 5452 7714.
